name: Neighborhood Scoring & Ranking Engine
target_workflow: Area comparison and recommendation based on customer preferences (budget, commute, lifestyle, family structure).
proposed_ai_capability: LLM-powered multi-criteria decision engine that scores and ranks neighborhoods using structured area profiles, commute data, school ratings, and safety metrics.
expected_business_value: Reduces consultant time per case by 40-50%, ensures consistent recommendations across staff, speeds up onboarding for new consultants.
key_risk: Bias in scoring due to incomplete or outdated area data; overfitting to historical patterns.
human_approval_requirement: Consultant must review and optionally adjust rankings before presenting to customer.
required_data: Area profiles (safety, cost, schools, amenities, transport), commute time matrices, historical customer preference-resolution pairs.
japan_enterprise_fit: High – directly addresses labor productivity and consistency, aligns with DX and kaizen improvement culture.
evidence_support: OECD labour shortage report, METI GENIAC workflow efficiency case, FSA governance framework.
why_now: Scattered area info is a critical pain point; AI can unify data and reduce manual comparison as labor shortages intensify.
refinement_notes: Make approval packet mandatory for all external, regulated, or irreversible outputs.
search_selection_reason: Selected after LATS-lite expansion because it has the strongest combination of feasibility, risk controllability, evidence grounding, and PoC buildability.
